cli.help.run:
Usage: deckent run <action>
  create --scope <id> --id <run> --command-id <id> --graph <file|->
    [--branch <file>] [--delivery-command-id <id>] [--json]
    [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  reserve --scope <id> --id <run> --command-id <id> --expected-revision <n>
    [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  inspect --scope <id> --id <run> [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  cancel --scope <id> --id <run> --command-id <id> --expected-revision <n>
    [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  close|resume --scope <id> --id <run> --command-id <id>
    --expected-revision <n> [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
Run creation admits a graph; reservation selects Tasks and generates Attempt
    identities. Neither command executes Tasks or accepts a caller verdict.
--graph - reads graph JSON from piped stdin.
The standard Run path uses the local service: deckent runtime serve.
cli.help.task:
Usage: deckent task <action>
  inspect --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
  execute --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id> --attempt <id> --generation <n>
    --layout-revision <id> [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  evaluate --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id> --attempt <id> --generation <n>
    --layout-revision <id> --command-id <id> --expected-revision <n> [--json]
    [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
  accept|reject --scope <id> --run <run> --task <task> --command-id <id>
    --expected-revision <n> [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
Execution records terminal process evidence; evaluation decides Task acceptance
    from recorded evidence. A terminal result alone is not acceptance.
  task patch-prepare|patch-preview --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id>
    --attempt <id> --generation <n> --layout-revision <id> [--json]
    patch-preview: [--stat|--diff] (diff is the default; not with --json)
  task integration-check|integration-prepare --scope <id> --run <id>
    --task <id> --attempt <id> --generation <n> --layout-revision <id>
    [--json] [--lang en|tr]
  integration-prepare: --command-id <id> --proposal <code>
  integration-prepare: [--replaces-command-id <id>]
  task integration-inspect --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id>
    --attempt <id> --generation <n> --layout-revision <id>
    --command-id <id> [--json]
  patch-preview, transcript, integration-inspect: --attempt,
    --generation and --layout-revision may all be omitted; the latest
    attempt of --run/--task is used (partial sets are a usage error)
  task integration-deliver --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id>
    --attempt <id> --generation <n> --layout-revision <id>
    --command-id <id> --candidate-command-id <id> [--json]
  task integration-adopt --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id> --attempt <id>
    --generation <n> --layout-revision <id> --command-id <id>
    --delivery-command-id <id> --target refs/heads/<branch>
    [--verification-run <run>] [--json]
  task integration-rollback --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id>
    --attempt <id> --generation <n> --layout-revision <id>
    --command-id <id> --adoption-command-id <id>
Adoption moves a configured branch that no worktree has checked out; it is
    verified only with --verification-run (kind from
    execution.adoption.verification).
  task transcript --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id> --attempt <id>
    --generation <n> --layout-revision <id> [--json]
Execution and evaluation use the local service: deckent runtime serve.
Patch preparation and preview use local policy/storage without that service.
cli.help.pool:
Usage: deckent pool <action>
  status [--scope <id>] [--pool <id>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
  hold|resume [--scope <id>] [--pool <id>] [--command-id <id>] [--reason <text>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
While a pool is held no new task is reserved; running work finishes and is evaluated; Run admission stays open; stop running work with run cancel. hold/resume need installation-level authority (pool hold|resume over all scopes). --pool defaults to the admission pool, --scope to terminal.scopeId.

cli.help.modelsSpending:
deckent models spending --input <file|-> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Read the exact scoped provider-spending account snapshot from the explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`. Input is schema 1: scopeId, budgetId, and budgetRevision. Reserved amounts include held reservations, but this view does not show hold reasons. The settled total may combine local calculations and provider-reported charges; source subtotals are not included. This is local recorded accounting evidence, not a provider invoice or an audited spending history.
cli.help.modelsAuditSpending:
deckent models audit-spending --input <file|-> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Record a bounded integrity audit for one exact provider-spending checkpoint through the explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`. Input is schema 1: commandId, scopeId, budgetId, budgetRevision, and expectedCheckpointDigest. It records an immutable audit receipt; it does not correct financial records, verify an invoice, or prove a complete invocation audit.
mcp.tool.inspectProviderSpending: Inspect one exact scoped provider-spending account snapshot. It returns recorded local reservations, including holds but not hold reasons, and exact settlement with its rounded projection. The settled total may combine local calculations and provider-reported charges; source subtotals are not included. It does not verify a provider invoice or a full spending-history audit.
mcp.tool.auditProviderSpending: Record one bounded integrity audit for an exact provider-spending checkpoint. It creates or replays an immutable audit receipt; it does not correct financial records, verify a provider invoice, or prove a complete invocation audit.

deckent [terminal] [--scope <id>] [--full-access]   interactive terminal (same
  as `terminal workline`)
  terminal status [--json] [--lang en|tr]

  terminal snapshot [--lang en|tr]
  terminal session [--scope <id>] [--lang en|tr]

Chat turns are governed model invocations through the local runtime service
  (`deckent runtime serve`) for the model named in `terminal.chat`. session is
  line mode and also reads piped input; workline needs an interactive terminal
  on stdin and stdout.

The scope defaults to `terminal.scopeId`. When no runtime service is running,
  the terminal starts one in the background; it keeps running after exit
  (`deckent runtime shutdown`).

--full-access opens the session in full access (tool calls run without asking;
  Deckent's own state, policy and credentials stay closed); it needs a company
  grant and cannot be switched into from inside a session.

monitor [--once|--json] [--install <id>] [--scope <id>] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]

Usage: deckent mcp <action>
  add [--scope local|project|user] [--transport stdio] [--env <KEY=value>]
    [--realm <realm>] [--timeout-ms <n>] [--yes|--no-approve]
    <name> -- <command> [args]
  add [--scope …] [--transport http] [--header '<Name: value>'] <name> <url>
  add-json [--scope local|project|user] [--yes|--no-approve] <name> <json>
  import [--from claude-code|claude-desktop|<file>] [--scope local|user]
  list
  get <name>
  remove <name> [--scope local|project|user]
  approve <name> [--always-ask <tool>] [--yes]
  revoke <name>
A header or env value may name a secret as $DECK:NAME (local, user scope).
Imported servers are not trusted: each asks for approval before it starts.
